remarks: **AVAILABLE AUGUST 11**Live in the Heart of Convenience! Just a 2-minute walk to the best pizza in Fairfield County and a 7-minute bike ride to the train station-yes, really! This beautiful townhouse offers two covered parking spots at no extra cost-a rare find!  Welcome to 130 Myrtle-a bright and inviting townhouse that checks all the boxes. Enjoy central air, an open layout, your own private balcony, in-unit laundry, and spacious bedrooms. You'll be right near it all: downtown, the mall, beaches, restaurants, highways-you name it.  Included in rent: water, sewer, trash, and parking (yup, two covered spots!). Tenant pays: electric, internet, and renters insurance.   No pets.  Credit 700+ required.
